Inclusion Criteria:
Healthy  [AND] and T2D (controlled by diet  [AND] and lifestyle  [OR] or metformin) volunteers; Age 18+; males  [OR] and females

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
For the healthy group:
  -  taking prescribed medication
  -  HbA1c above 48mmol/mol  [OR] (or 6

left.raw_text:
5%)
  -  pregnant  [OR] or breastfeeding
  -  blood donation in the last three months
  -  unable to give written informed consent
  -  eating disorders such as anorexia, [OR]  bulimia, [OR]  binge eating  [OR] or night eating syndrome

-  significant health issue
  -  taking vitamin  [OR] or mineral supplements (unless they agree to discontinue supplementation 2 weeks or more before the start of the study)
  -  Food allergies/ [OR] intolerances
For the T2D groups:
  -  T2D controlled by medication other than metformin
  -  pregnant  [OR] or breastfeeding
  -  blood donation in the last three months
  -  unable to give written informed consent
  -  eating disorders such as anorexia, [OR]  bulimia, [OR]  binge eating  [OR] or night eating syndrome

right.raw_text:
-  any other significant health issue other than T2D
  -  taking vitamin  [OR] or mineral supplements (unless they agree to discontinue supplementation 2 weeks before the start of the study)
